name: Vam Kare
source:
Two vampire brothers moved to a new town.
The one they met there is an irreplaceable "bait"...!?

The younger brother who hates his "bait".
The older brother who falls in love with his "bait". But he has a story...?
translation:
两个吸血鬼兄弟搬到了一个新城镇。
在那里遇到的人是无可替代的“诱饵”……！？

讨厌他的“诱饵”的弟弟。
爱上他的“诱饵”的哥哥。但他有故事……？
